description: Server-side route handler for a board detail page in a SvelteKit application. Handles data loading and actions such as creating columns and tasks, updating tasks, deleting tasks, and moving tasks within a project management interface, interacting with a Django REST API.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches board details, columns, and tasks data from the API, transforming it into a format suitable for the frontend.

methods.name: createColumn
methods.description: Handles creating a new column in the board.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Handles creating a new task within a specified column.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Handles updating details of a task, moving it between columns, or changing its properties.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Handles moving a task to a different column, typically via drag-and-drop.
